properties.name: WhoisFreaks - newly registered domain seen in threat feed
properties.query:
let nrd = union WhoisFreaksNRD_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDNoWhois_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| distinct domain_name;
WhoisFreaksThreat_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| join kind=inner (nrd) on $left.domain == $right.domain_name
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by domain, threat_type
| project TimeGenerated, domain, threat_type, confidence, domain_name
properties.description: Identifies newly registered domains that are later observed in WhoisFreaks threat feeds. The rule runs hourly and matches threat rows ingested in the last hour against domains seen in the NRD feeds during the previous seven days, so each threat row is alerted on once.
